requests.name: 封印肢体1
requests.design: DESIGN 1 — OPEN CLAW / ARM: one spectral LEFT forearm and hand reaching diagonally from upper-left to lower-right. Four long coarse tapered fingers plus a distinct hooked thumb, spread into an unmistakable OPEN grasp; fingers are opaque shadow shapes, not human skin. Forearm bends slightly, dark angular wrist collar. ONE short pale chain loops over the forearm and passes across the wrist, with a little trailing end. Broad palm and open finger silhouette is the distinguishing feature. Do not add an elbow/upper arm/second hand.
requests.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone GAME CARD CUTOUT ASSET with a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA BACKGROUND, square canvas. No backdrop color, no ground, no rectangular panel, no checkerboard drawn into the artwork. The entire exterior around the subject must be transparent; every gap inside the chain links must also remain transparent. Isolate one sealed spectral limb fragment, no full character, no head, no torso, no other body part, no scene. No contact shadow, haze sheet, gradients, glow fog, particles, text, logo, watermark, UI or card border.

This is one of FOUR distinct pieces of an ancient SEALED SHADOW ENTITY. Non-gory magical apparition/relic, NOT severed human flesh. Upper endpoint dissolves into TWO or THREE large opaque dark ink-brush notches, no exposed bone, wounds or blood. Body is matte near-black/navy and muted dusty violet, with one restrained slate-teal accent plane. Bind it with one broad chalk-gray rectangular-link chain and a plain dark collar bearing a single simple ivory diamond seal mark (no lettering or runes). Chain is 4–7 LARGE blocky links with clearly open transparent holes, drawn as bold broad-brush shapes, NOT many tiny shining rings. Limited marks, no decorative jewels or dense carvings. Only the limb, collar and short chain are visible.
Images1/2 provide broad opaque paint grammar only; DO NOT copy people, outfits, faces or backgrounds.

STYLE: VERY ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME GAME PROP, a bold unfinished gouache color sketch. Large connected silhouettes made with chunky opaque strokes; a broad base color plus ONE grouped shadow and a few gray/violet blunt dabs. Irregular handmade edges, selected broken stroke ends, slight paint misregistration. Large calm interiors. FEWER WIDER marks, no dense chips, facets, hairlike scratches, grain/canvas filters or all-over texture. Coarse shape construction, no refined leather/metal anatomy detail or photorealism. Fingers/foot joints and chain readable with only a few structural accents. Matte hard-edge grouped values, no glossy 3D, airbrush shading, realistic materials, bloom or smooth rim glow. Sharp enough silhouette for small cards, middle-value accents make the near-black figure readable against dark UI.
COMPOSITION: one complete isolated object occupies about 75–80% square height, generous transparent margin on ALL sides. Limb and chain must not touch or be cropped by frame. No cast shadow onto an invisible floor. Output RGBA transparency.

requests.name: 封印肢体2
requests.design: DESIGN 2 — CLOSED FIST / ARM: one spectral RIGHT forearm bent in a strong shallow L-shape, diagonal from lower-left to upper-right, ending in a large compact clenched FIST. Thumb clearly wraps the grouped fingers. Forearm and fist form a sturdy blocky mass with a simple navy-violet cuff. ONE short chalk-gray chain is pulled taut across the cuff and drapes beneath the bent wrist, transparent negative space between loop and limb. CLOSED FIST and opposite diagonal distinguish this from the open-claw part; no open reaching fingers, extra elbow, second hand or other body.

requests.name: 封印肢体3
requests.design: DESIGN 3 — BENT LOWER LEG: one spectral LOWER LEG and broad clawed BOOT/FOOT in a compact bent sideways pose, shin angles from upper-right toward center-left, ankle turns sharply and foot points toward lower-right. A few simple blocky toe/heel shapes; no realistic toes or skin. Dark violet flat shin armor-like plane, plain ankle sealing collar. ONE short gray chain loops from collar around the angular foot, with open negative spaces. Strong Z/L-like bent silhouette distinguishes it from hands and straight-leg part. No thigh/torso/extra feet, no floor or shadow.

requests.name: 封印肢体4
requests.design: DESIGN 4 — EXTENDED LOWER LEG: one spectral LOWER LEG with a LONG straight tapering shin ending in a pointed armored-looking FOOT angled down-left. Overall tall slanted spear-like silhouette, heel and three coarse toe wedges readable as a FOOT, not a hand. A broad dusty violet shin plane, dark sealing collar higher on the shin. ONE short chalk-gray chain wraps diagonally down the shin in a single loose spiral then ends next to ankle, all holes transparent. Tall elongated silhouette distinguishes this from the compact bent leg; no extra limb, floor, human flesh or wounds.
